versions.changelog: Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

- Initial release of grid-notice-voice.
- Converts a written grid-matter list into 8–20 labeled grid notice voice clips.
- Follows a strict workflow using only approved written input; does not invent notices or results.
- Handles both catalog and staff-cloned voices with explicit consent and transparent billing.
- Routes other material types (narration, civil-affairs lists, elder/holiday schedules) to designated skills.
- All operations run through the bundled MCP client; no direct API or connector usage.
